text:
```yaml
name: Run tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
      - feature/**
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
      - feature/**

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.14
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.14"
          allow-prereleases: true

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: "3.14"
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Run tests
        run: uvx pytest -o junitxml=pytest.xml

      - name: Post pytest results
        uses: pmeier/pytest-results-action@v0.7.2
        with:
          path: pytest.xml
          summary: "Pytest results"
          display-options: "summary"
          fail-on-empty: true
          title: "Pytest Results"
```
